finding: For the same Shanghai room (Radisson Blu New World Superior), two sessions captured different February totals: $922 with a Genius sign-in and $1,114/$1,116 public. Radisson Collection Hyland's $696 promo was identical in two sampled windows, so its saving comes from the promotion, not the date. Every sampled later Radisson Blu window is dearer than 15–22 Feb; Beijing's Grand Hyatt was identical in February and March. 'Cheapest' here means cheapest of the sampled and quoted windows, never all possible dates.
